rows.question: What is the maximum earned leave that can be taken at a time?
rows.rawAnswer: The maximum amount of earned leave that can be granted to an employee at a time shall be 180 days [S191]. However, earned Leave may be taken at a time up to 300 days as leave preparatory to retirement [S191].

rows.question: How many days of earned leave can be encashed with LTC?
rows.rawAnswer: While availing LTC, encashment of earned leave up to 10 days on each occasion and a maximum of 60 days in the entire service are permissible [S193].

kept.text: While availing LTC, encashment of earned leave up to 10 days on each occasion and a maximum of 60 days in the entire service are permissible.

rows.question: How long is the vacation for teaching staff?
rows.rawAnswer: Teaching staff can avail vacation for 60 days during the period when the semester is closed [S197]. The maximum vacation that can be taken is 60 days [S199].

kept.text: Teaching staff can avail vacation for 60 days during the period when the semester is closed.
The maximum vacation that can be taken is 60 days.

rows.question: How many days of half pay leave are given each year?
rows.rawAnswer: Every employee shall be credited with half pay leave in advance in two installments of 10 days each on the 1st January and 1st July of every calendar year [S211].

kept.text: Every employee shall be credited with half pay leave in advance in two installments of 10 days each on the 1st January and 1st July of every calendar year.

rows.question: How long is maternity leave?
rows.rawAnswer: Maternity Leave is granted for a period of 180 days for a female employee with less than 2 surviving children [S269]. Maternity Leave not exceeding 45 days may also be granted in case of miscarriage including abortion on production of a medical certificate issued by a Registered Medical Practitioner [S271].

rows.question: How long is paternity leave?
rows.rawAnswer: Paternity Leave is granted to a married male employee with less than two surviving children for a period of 15 days [S282]. During Paternity Leave, the employee shall be paid salary equal to the pay drawn immediately before proceedings on leave [S285].

rows.question: How long is adoption leave?
rows.rawAnswer: Adoption Leave is granted to a female employee with fewer than two surviving children on the valid adoption of a child below the age of one year for a period of 180 days immediately after the date of valid adoption from 22 - 07 - 2009 [S293]. The maximum admissible period of Adoption Leave is regulated as follows: up to one year if the adopted child's age is less than one month [S299(a)], up to 6 months if the age is 2-6 months [S300(b)], and up to 3 months if the age is 7-10 months [S300(c)].

rows.question: Within how many days must I apply to convert one kind of leave into another?
rows.rawAnswer: You should apply for such conversion within 30 days of completion of the relevant spell of leave [S56]. This conversion cannot be claimed as a matter of right [S57].

rows.question: After how long of continuous absence is an employee treated as having resigned?
rows.rawAnswer: An employee who remains absent for a continuous period exceeding five years other than on foreign service or other service approved by MHRD shall be deemed to have resigned from the service of the Institute [S97]. This applies whether the absence is with or without leave [S97].

rows.question: How many days of earned leave do staff get in a year?
rows.rawAnswer: The Earned Leave admissible to a member of the staff shall be 30 days in a calendar year [S117]. However, the maximum amount of Earned Leave that can be granted to a member of the staff at a time shall be 180 days [S129].

rows.question: How many days of casual leave are allowed in a year?
rows.rawAnswer: Casual Leave is subject to a maximum of 8 days in a calendar year [S66]. CL should not be granted for more than 5 days at any time, except under special circumstances [S70].

rows.question: What is the maximum study leave in the whole service?
rows.rawAnswer: The maximum period of study leave in the entire service is 24 months [S210]. This may be granted at a stretch or in different spells [S210].

rows.question: How many days of child care leave can be taken in the whole service?
rows.rawAnswer: Women employees having minor children may be granted CCL for a maximum period of 730 days during their entire service [S222](a).

kept.text: Women employees having minor children may be granted CCL for a maximum period of 730 days during their entire service (a).

rows.question: What salary is paid during child care leave?
rows.rawAnswer: During the period of Child Care Leave (CCL), the woman employee's leave salary will be equal to the pay drawn immediately before proceeding on leave [S225]. CCL should be granted at 100% salary for the first 365 days and 80% salary for the next 365 days [S228].

rows.question: Up to what age of the child can child care leave be taken?
rows.rawAnswer: Child care leave shall not be admissible if the child is 18 years of age or older [S224].

kept.text: Child care leave shall not be admissible if the child is 18 years of age or older.

rows.question: What is the shortest child care leave I can take at a time?
rows.rawAnswer: Child Care Leave (CCL) may be availed of in more than one spell [S226]. CCL may be granted to single mothers for six spells in a calendar year [S233].

rows.question: How long is paternity leave?
rows.rawAnswer: Male staff with less than or equal to two children may be granted 15 days Paternity Leave during the confinement of his wife for childbirth [S188]. Paternity Leave is also admissible on valid adoption of a child below the age of one year [S189].

rows.question: How many days of special casual leave are given for a vasectomy?
rows.rawAnswer: Male employees are admissible a maximum of 5 working days for a vasectomy operation [S110](i)(aa). If the operation is for a second time due to failure of the first, another 5 days are admissible with a medical certificate [S111](i).

rows.question: What is the maximum leave not due in the whole service?
rows.rawAnswer: LND during the entire service is limited to a maximum of 360 days [S163].

rows.question: How much leave can an aggrieved female staff member get during an inquiry?
rows.rawAnswer: An aggrieved female staff member can be granted leave up to a maximum of 90 days during an inquiry under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 [S241][S241].
